notes: Seeded-defect inventory for judgment-layer regression evals (plan 2026-07-06 §6, WS-4). Fixtures carry inline <!-- DEFECT --> / <!-- CONTROL --> markers; a scored run must be produced WITHOUT showing the reviewer agent those markers (strip comments before dispatch, or instruct the pass to ignore HTML comments is NOT sufficient — strip them). Coherence fixtures added 2026-09-21 for SAFEGUARD Check 9 under references/ARGUMENT_COHERENCE.md. Splits: `development` fixtures may be scored and tuned against; `held_out` fixtures must not be scored during development. Contamination limit, stated rather than hidden: every fixture here carries `independently_curated: false` because it was authored by the same agent that wrote the obligation. Held-out therefore means held out from tuning, not from authorship, and no number from these files qualifies judgment quality. Final held-out qualification requires fixtures curated by the independent reviewer and acceptance thresholds fixed prospectively with the review owner.

findings_file_schema.description: A run names fixture, pass, optional evaluator {host, model, configuration}, and findings [{finding_code, severity, line, location_hint}]. line is a one-based line in the comment-stripped fixture; preserve newlines when blinding. Baseline comparisons require evaluator identity.
findings_file_schema.matching_rule: Exact normalized code family and exact defect line; M-n aliases C-8/M-n. Each finding matches at most one defect; duplicates and wrong locations remain extra findings. P1 counts every exact P2-gated family as a false positive. No substring credit.
findings_file_schema.split_rule: A baseline comparison is refused across splits. A development number is never reported as a held-out number, and neither is qualification.
